title: Trend with volume behind it
intro_say: Angstrom Signals. | Worked example: a trend with volume behind it.

steps.say: A rising trend is more convincing when volume backs it. | Let's ask for both.

steps.screen: Set editor: adding "My Trend" and the starter Group Flow
steps.say: Add My Trend, and the starter Flow Group, which reads whether volume is buying or selling.

steps.screen: Lines: "My Trend is Bullish" and "Flow is Buying"
steps.say: Line one: My Trend is Bullish. | Line two: Flow's score is at least plus thirty, | the level the dashboard calls Buying.

steps.screen: The veto inside My Trend, shown briefly
steps.say: And because My Trend already has its ranging veto, a choppy, sideways market won't count.

steps.screen: Save; Prism: + and ▶ on All crypto
steps.say: Save it, add it to Prism, and run it, | here as of the thirteenth of March 2024.
Yes means the trend is up and volume agrees. | A No tells you which one is missing.
